component.name: jsBudbrainLimiter
component.summary: A limiter for the whole system: louder, never over the top

description.p: Music, videos, games, calls in the browser — everything your computer plays runs through a precise limiter. Raise the level as far as you like: the ceiling you set is never crossed, not even for the briefest peak.
Each channel has its own gain, ceiling, attack, release, knee, sidechain high-pass and mix, with a bypass of its own. Couple left and right to turn both at once, or set them apart.

Two spectrum displays show for each channel what goes in, what comes out, what was raised and what the limiter took away — band by band. Level meters, gain-reduction history and peak readouts complete the picture.

ul.li: Look-ahead limiter per channel, left and right
Gain, ceiling, attack, release, knee, sidechain high-pass and mix
True peak: catches even the briefest peaks
Stereo link and coupled or separate channel controls
Output fader with level meters for both channels
Two spectrum displays: input, output, raised and limited
Works together with jsBudbrainCompressor, jsBudbrainEqualizer and jsBudbrainsFxStudio
Ready-made settings and your own, saved under a name
Mute button for when the phone rings
Choose which speakers or headphones to use
Small window that stays on top
Starts when you log in, if you like

description.p: First release: a limiter for the whole system with its own controls for the left and right channel, an output fader, two spectrum displays and 44 languages.
